legal.providers.title: Model providers
legal.providers.meta: Who receives your text, why, where, for how long, and on what basis
legal.providers.intro: This Register is part of our Privacy Policy and applies to every user, wherever you live. To run a debate we send its text to the AI providers below, and what you type in the support chat goes to the support chat's model. They never receive your email address, your account, your IP address or your payment details. Our contracts exclude using your content to train their models [publish only once verified for each provider]. We tell you before a new provider receives any data. Square brackets mark facts we have not confirmed yet.

legal.health.title: Consumer health data privacy policy
legal.health.meta: For residents of Washington, Nevada and Connecticut
legal.health.s01.title: What this policy covers
legal.health.s01.body: Some US state laws, including Washington's My Health My Data Act, require a separate policy for consumer health data. This page is that policy; our privacy policy covers everything else.
legal.health.s02.title: Health data we may process
legal.health.s02.body: We do not ask for health data. It reaches us only if you type it into a question or a challenge, for example in a debate about a treatment you are having.
legal.health.s03.title: Why we process it
legal.health.s03.body: Only to run and store that debate and, if you choose, to publish it. We never use it for advertising and we never sell it.
legal.health.s04.title: Who receives it
legal.health.s04.body: The AI providers that run your debate receive its text; the Model providers page lists them. Our hosting provider stores it for us. We share it with no one else.
legal.health.s05.title: Your rights
legal.health.s05.item1: confirm whether we hold your consumer health data and get a copy of it;
legal.health.s05.item2: get the list of every third party that received it;
legal.health.s05.item3: withdraw your consent and have it deleted.
legal.health.s06.title: How to use them
legal.health.s06.body: From Settings, or by writing to privacy@dezbatere.ro. We reply within 45 days. If we refuse a request, you can appeal by replying to our answer.
